definitions.explanation: A humorous play on words, often using homophones or similar sounds.
Elegant humor or sophisticated style (often in the phrase お洒落).

examples.japanese: ⟦くだらない→くだらない：09416_kudaranai⟧{洒落|しゃれ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}わないで→言う：00515_iu⟧。
{洒落|しゃれ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The situation became no laughing matter.
examples.notes: 洒落にならない is a common expression meaning 'not funny' or 'no laughing matter'.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}っ{飛|と}んだ→吹っ飛ぶ：noentry⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{典型的|てんけいてき}な→典型的：04801_tenkeiteki⟧⟦{駄洒落|だじゃれ}→駄洒落：noentry⟧⟦だ→だ：noentry⟧。
examples.english: "Futon ga futtonda" (the futon flew away) is a classic pun.
examples.notes: 駄洒落 refers to a bad pun or corny joke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}むと→飲む：00322_nomu⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{洒落|しゃれ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{笑|わら}わせようとする→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: When my father drinks, he always tries to make the family laugh by telling puns.

examples.japanese: {洒落|しゃれ}た⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦だね→だ：noentry⟧。
{洒落|しゃれ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}いている→効く：01932_kiku⟧。
examples.notes: 洒落が利く means something is witty or clever.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洒落|しゃれ}た⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This room has a stylish atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洒落|しゃれ}た⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。

⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洒落|しゃれ}た⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{満席|まんせき}→満席：07585_manseki⟧⟦だ→だ：noentry⟧。
examples.english: There are many stylish cafes in the city, and they're always full on weekends.

notes:
{洒落|しゃれ} primarily refers to puns or wordplay, but also appears in expressions related to style and humor.

Common expressions:
- {駄洒落|だじゃれ} (bad pun, corny joke)
- {洒落|しゃれ}にならない (no laughing matter, not funny)
- {洒落|しゃれ}が{利|き}いている (witty, clever)
- お{洒落|しゃれ} (fashionable, stylish)

Japanese puns often use homophones:
- {布団|ふとん}が{吹|ふ}っ{飛|と}んだ (futon ga futtonda = the futon blew away)
- {猫|ねこ}が{寝|ね}ころんだ (neko ga nekoronda = the cat lay down)

Note: お{洒落|しゃれ} (stylish/fashionable) is a different but related usage.
